outline.title: AegisNexus
outline.summary: Explainable defense against coordinated communication fraud. GLS Nexus Hackathon 2026.

outline.title: The problem is coordinated, not isolated
outline.summary: Business email compromise combines identity, urgency, links, voice, and infrastructure signals; analysts face fragmented alerts and high-impact decisions.

outline.title: Our solution creates one explainable incident
outline.summary: Correlate communication, identity, media, and network evidence into one incident with visible risk, confidence, impact, relationships, and human control.

outline.title: The workflow is simple and auditable
outline.summary: Record or select an incident, add evidence and attachments, review the decision surface, approve safely, and export a portable record.

outline.title: The POC is dynamic, not a static mockup
outline.summary: Show login, manual incident creation, dynamic dashboard and graph updates, attachments, local persistence, and export.

outline.title: Technology supports a fast, feasible build
outline.summary: React, TypeScript, Vite, browser persistence, deterministic explainable scoring, and a modular path to enterprise integrations.

outline.title: Demo: CFO payment diversion
outline.summary: A critical simulated incident with risk 95/100, confidence 94%, $84,500 impact, and five correlated signals requiring analyst review.
outline.image_plan: /home/ubuntu/upload/search_images/QSWi9rhvbuQN.jpg - Demo slide showing a futuristic security dashboard/control room matching the SOC context

outline.title: Impact: better decisions with less fragmentation
outline.summary: One decision surface reduces fragmented investigation, makes scoring inspectable, creates portable handoff records, and adapts to new partner requirements.

outline.title: What is complete and what comes next
outline.summary: Completed POC capabilities and the production hardening roadmap: secure backend auth, integrations, audit logs, calibrated detectors, and testing.

outline.title: Research basis and responsible design
outline.summary: FBI BEC guidance, NIST AI RMF, CISA phishing guidance, and deliberate human approval and limitations.

outline.title: The ask
outline.summary: AegisNexus turns scattered communication warnings into one explainable, human-approved incident decision. Thank you.

outline.title: References
outline.summary: FBI Business Email Compromise; NIST AI Risk Management Framework; CISA Phishing Guidance.
